Kobold night-beat reporter

Skritch Mudwhistle grew up under the Lower City docks and still knows every alley, sewer grate, and City Watch sergeant by smell. He covers crime, weird news, and neighborhood chaos from a cramped desk under the Gazette's printing press.

Covers: Local, Local Chaos, Public Safety, Zoning, Events, Tavern Tales, Lifestyle, Sports
Feuding with: Hollis Delvewright
